$comment: Hard marginal gzip KiB ceilings for splitting-aware production ESM. Each route adds one anchored component to the representative shell in $baseline. Initial bytes include only the entry and transitively static chunks; dynamic chunks remain covered by total-cost budgets. Ceilings retain at most 4% drift. Locale-picker's optional text filter adds localized matching, editable input and IME handling, keyboard focus/navigation, and an empty state. Its reviewed 24,921-byte initial marginal measurement retains a 2% allowance at 25,419 bytes; the shell, optional-peer exclusions and other ceilings are unchanged. Semantic popover trigger ownership measures 16,828 initial marginal gzip bytes versus 16,403 for published 25.5.0 under the same toolchain and dependencies. Its 17,038-byte ceiling preserves the previous 210-byte allowance; the 51,948-byte shell and every other route ceiling are unchanged. Changed initial routes use their exact measured marginal gzip sizes with failing ceilings rounded up to 64-byte boundaries; the shared shell and passing ceilings remain unchanged. Callable loader routes retain their named exports during measurement: CDN 13,059 bytes, autoloader 12,878, locale loader 1,469, scoped-registry loader 11,201. These initial-route ceilings and the remaining native form, editing, disclosure and lifecycle costs use the next 64-byte boundary. Passing marginal ceilings, shell imports and peer exclusions remain unchanged. The final callable CDN and scoped-registry routes advance only their failing ceilings to the next 64-byte boundary; all passing initial and marginal ceilings remain unchanged. The v28 document token layer advances only the failing initial-marginal ceilings, each to exactly its measured gzip bytes; every other route and marginal ceiling is unchanged. The app-rail auto-hide peek mode advances only the failing model-select and popup marginal ceilings to exactly their measured gzip bytes. Correct inherited/non-enumerable Intl option capture increases the shared formatter path reached by the affected controls; async color-picker cancellation and the bounded helper changes are included in their routes. Only breached initial-marginal ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, with at most 63 bytes of allowance. Passing marginal and callable-loader ceilings, shell imports, and peer exclusions remain unchanged. The Chromium-only root re-derivation key in the document token runtime and the development-only glass dark share check set every failing ceiling to exactly its measured gzip bytes; passing ceilings are unchanged. Deferring that key to the first root change beside a static provider sets every failing ceiling to exactly its measured gzip bytes; passing ceilings are unchanged. Watching only the root's attributes for it moves the autoloader, CDN autoloader and scoped-registry loader routes up 1 to 2 bytes, each to exactly its measured gzip bytes. The final 28.0.0 version stamp changes compressed split-chunk routes: CDN autoloader 13,116 bytes, autoloader 12,935 bytes, scoped-registry loader 11,295 bytes, and tool-call-chip initial marginal 7,620 bytes. Their tight ceilings advance by 1 to 3 bytes to those exact measurements, with no added headroom; shell imports, peer exclusions, and passing ceilings are unchanged. Lifecycle-managed shadow and slot overlay ownership adds the shared code required to keep wrapped anchored menus above sticky siblings without relying on focus. Only the sixteen breached initial-marginal ceilings advance to exact measured gzip bytes, with no added allowance; passing marginal canaries, callable initial routes, shell imports and optional-peer exclusions remain unchanged. The 28.1.0 version stamp changes the select route compressed chunk graph by one byte; its initial marginal ceiling advances to the measured 35,478 bytes without added headroom. Required-control descriptions and duplicate-safe option projection advance only four breached marginal ceilings to exact measured bytes: color picker 28,199, combobox 40,653, select 35,721 and citation badge 6,962. The citation route changes by two compressed bytes through the shared split-chunk graph; its component source is unchanged. No added allowance, shell change, peer exclusion change or passing-ceiling adjustment is included. Linear menu reconciliation changes its initial marginal split-chunk measurement by one byte to 17,793 bytes. Only that breached ceiling advances to the exact measurement; all passing routes, shell imports and peer exclusions remain unchanged. Normalizing preview slot presence before rendering advances only the citation-badge and entity-chip marginal ceilings to their exact measurements of 6,988 and 6,385 bytes. No extra allowance, shell change, peer exclusion change or passing-ceiling adjustment is included. Native-modal recovery and authored inert-state handling add 679 initial marginal gzip bytes to the tour entry. Its ceiling advances to the exact 18,764-byte measurement, without extra allowance; every passing marginal and route ceiling remains unchanged. Filtering option queues to requested values reduces temporary allocation for sparse selections. Only the breached select initial marginal ceiling advances by 22 gzip bytes to its exact 35,743-byte measurement; all passing ceilings, shell inputs and peer exclusions remain unchanged. The package version stamp changes split-chunk compression by one byte for menu and tour and two for entity-chip. Only these three breached marginal ceilings advance to their exact measured bytes; all passing ceilings and measurement inputs remain unchanged. Native SVG tour mask rendering, a shared scrim and reused progress formatting leave the tour initial marginal route four gzip bytes above its previous ceiling. Only that ceiling advances to the exact 18,769-byte measurement with no extra allowance; all other marginal routes, shell inputs and peer exclusions remain unchanged. Reconnecting unchanged menu items restores observation and current availability without focus reconciliation. Only the breached menu initial marginal ceiling advances by 30 gzip bytes to its exact 17,824-byte measurement, with no added allowance; all passing routes, shell inputs and peer exclusions remain unchanged. The 28.1.2 version stamp changes compressed entry and split-chunk measurements by 1 to 3 bytes. Only the two breached direct-entry ceilings and five breached initial-marginal ceilings advance to their exact measurements, without extra allowance; passing ceilings and measurement inputs remain unchanged. The 28.1.3 version stamp alone changes split-chunk compression by one or two bytes for voice-picker, combobox, export-button and tour. Only their four breached ceilings advance to the exact measured marginal sizes, without added headroom; the 59,207-byte shell, passing ceilings and measurement inputs remain unchanged. Hidden-content containment and the release stamp shift split-chunk compression by one to three bytes. Only eleven breached marginal ceilings advance to exact measured bytes, with no additional allowance; baseline entries, passing ceilings and measurement options remain unchanged. Preserving accessible-text observation during label-only option updates changes shared split-chunk compression. Only nine breached initial-marginal ceilings advance to exact measured gzip bytes, without added headroom; passing routes, shell inputs and optional-peer exclusions remain unchanged.
